title: Say Your Name
summary: A night nurse records the one test she trusts for telling the sick from the well, and then it is her turn.

beats.text: Recording. I am a nurse, and this is the only test that works: ask their name.
The sick forget it. They open their mouths, and nothing comes.
Forty people queued in the school gym tonight. I asked each softly.
Thirty-nine answered at once. One man smiled and shook his head.
beats.speaker: man

beats.text: I walked him to the quiet ward. He went without a fight.
A girl asked who would test me. I laughed. I was fine.
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: But my hands had been cold since morning. I checked my arm. Nothing.
So I set this camera on the gurney and asked myself, out loud.
My name is... It is on my badge. I only had to read it.
I said it, clear as a bell. The girl clapped. I was only tired.
